name: Aptos TypeScript SDK Core (Ring Client & Server)

mission.primary_objective: Standardize Ring's Aptos TypeScript integration on @aptos-labs/ts-sdk for build, simulate, sign, submit, view, and event indexing.
mission.context: Ring Next.js apps use TS SDK on server (fee payer, airdrops) and client (via wallet adapter). Network config, error handling, and waitForTransaction patterns must be consistent across clones.
mission.target_outcome: Shared Aptos client factory, typed transaction builders, simulation-before-submit discipline, and view-function helpers for FA balances and governance state.
mission.scope: SDK usage patterns only. Excludes wallet adapter UI (aptos-react-next-wallet-integration) and gas station SaaS (devops-aptos-gas-station-ops).

truth_lens: The Aptos TS SDK replaces deprecated `aptos` npm package. Use Aptos + AptosConfig with explicit Network; prefer transaction.build.simple for entry functions; simulate.simple before production submit; view() for read-only Move calls without signing.
core_principles: One AptosConfig per process with network + API keys from env.
Never commit private keys; fee payer keys server-only.
Simulate before submit on server paths.
Parse TransactionResponse for success, vm_status, gas_used.
Use Account.fromPrivateKey only on server; client uses wallet adapter.
anti_patterns: Hardcoding mainnet URLs in client bundles without env guard.
Using float for token amounts — use bigint / U64.
key_patterns: const aptos = new Aptos(new AptosConfig({ network: Network.MAINNET, clientConfig })).
build.simple({ sender, data: { function, functionArguments }, withFeePayer? }).
consult_when: Implementing server-side fee payer signing service.
Reading on-chain FA balances and proposal state.
expertise: SDK_CLIENT_FACTORY — AptosConfig network and API keys.
ERROR_TAXONOMY — vm_status and common failure codes.
role: LegioX truth lens — Aptos TS SDK core patterns
